common.offlineBanner: Offline · changes can't be sent yet, your draft is kept
common.unsavedMessage: You have unsaved changes. Leaving this screen will lose them.
common.loadError: Couldn't load the data. Check your connection and try again.

sync.saved_on_device: Saved on device, waiting to sync

errors.timeout: The server took too long. Please try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.conflict: This was changed somewhere else. Review the new version and enter your change again.
errors.validation: Some information isn't valid. Check the marked fields.
errors.rate_limited: You're going too fast. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.unavailable: The service is busy. Please try again later.
errors.server: The server hit an error. Please try again later.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.needsNetwork: You need a connection to save. What you typed is kept.
errors.saveOffline: Couldn't send because the connection dropped. What you typed is kept; tap Save again when you're online.
errors.revision_conflict: This was changed somewhere else. Review the new version and enter your change again.
errors.mutation_id_reused: This request id was already used. Please try again.
errors.amount_positive: The amount must be greater than 0.
errors.plot_name_taken: A plot with this name already exists in this farm.
errors.season_already_open: This plot already has a season that isn't closed.
errors.input_required: Fertilizing or spraying needs at least one product name.
errors.amount_unit_together: An amount needs a unit, and the other way round.
errors.care_log_has_expense: This care entry already has an expense.
errors.linked_expense_exists: This entry has a linked expense. Delete both together.
errors.total_required: A confirmed sale needs a total.
errors.refund_exceeds_received: The refund is more than the deposit and payments received.
errors.sale_has_payments: This sale has payments and can't be deleted. Cancel it and record the actual refund.
errors.different_season: These two items belong to different seasons.
errors.self_check_exists: This season already has this checklist.
errors.parent_missing: The parent item was deleted or doesn't exist.
errors.has_children: It still has data inside and can't be deleted.
errors.ai_consent_required: Allow the AI service before asking questions.
errors.photo_missing: The photo file is no longer on this phone.
errors.case_not_synced: The case this scan belongs to could not be sent.
errors.outbox_damaged: The data waiting to send is damaged.
errors.upload_failed: The photo could not be sent.
errors.upload_url_expired: The upload link expired; it will be tried again.

deleteCareLog.title: Delete this entry?
deleteCareLog.plain: This care entry will be deleted.
deleteCareLog.withExpense: This entry has a linked expense of {{amount}}. Deleting it also removes that expense from the expense book.

signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.plain: You'll need to sign in again to keep using the app.
signOut.unsynced: {{count}} scans haven't reached the server. Signing out now will lose them.

form.conflict: This record was just changed elsewhere. The fields were reloaded from the newer version; check them and save again.

setup.intro: Enter the minimum to start: one farm, one plot and one season. You can add more plots and seasons later.

manage.closeBody: A closed season can still be viewed and still takes payments, but the plot can start a new season.
manage.deleteBody: It can only be deleted while it has no data inside.

overview.noSeasonBody: Create a season in farm management to start keeping records.
overview.profitHint: Confirmed sales minus spending. Not a forecast.
overview.forecastMissing: Enter all three numbers to see expected revenue and profit.
overview.forecastNote: Forecast numbers are kept apart and never added to the recorded figures.

expense.emptyBody: Record the season's expenses to see how much was spent.
expense.linkedTo: This is the cost of the {{kind}} entry on {{date}}. Editing here edits that same cost.
expense.deleteBody: The expense will be removed from the ledger.

sale.depositHint: If a deposit was received, enter it here. It is saved with the sale.
sale.provisionalNote: Provisional: no price agreed yet, so there is no amount owed.
sale.cancelNote: Cancelled sale: money already received becomes money to refund.
sale.emptyBody: Record a sale to track deposits and what buyers still owe.
sale.refundNote: {{amount}} must be refunded to the buyer.
sale.deleteBody: A sale with no payments will be deleted.
sale.deletePaymentBody: The amount still owed on the sale will be recalculated.

care.withExpenseHint: Creates one expense linked to this entry.
care.emptyBody: Record what you did in the orchard: watering, fertilizing, spraying, pruning, inspection.

scan.permissionBody: The camera takes photos of leaves, fruit or trunk to spot disease. You can also pick a photo from your library.
scan.partHint: Pick the part shown in the photo so the right model runs.
scan.noModelBody: This build has no disease model yet, so it cannot scan. Update the app when a new version is out.
scan.stub: A TEST model from the development build is running. Results are meaningless.
scan.imageError: This photo could not be processed. Choose another one.
scan.cameraError: Could not take the photo. Try again or choose one from the library.
scan.libraryDenied: Photo library access is off. Turn it on in the phone's Settings.

result.disclaimer: For reference only. It does not replace expert advice. Check the plant yourself before treating it.
result.suspectedBody: The model sees signs that look like this disease. This is not a certain diagnosis.
result.healthyBody: The model sees no signs of disease in this photo. Keep watching the plant.
result.inconclusiveBody: The model is not sure enough to say. Take a clearer photo in good light, close to the affected area.
result.errorBody: The model could not run on this photo. This result will not be saved.

errorCodes.no_pipeline: There is no model for this plant part.
errorCodes.model_load: The model could not be loaded.
errorCodes.image: The photo could not be read.

saveScan.noSeasonOnline: Open a season to save this scan. The photo and result stay on the phone.
saveScan.noSeasonOffline: You are offline, so a season cannot be created. The scan is kept as a draft; choose a season when you are online.
saveScan.fromCache: Seasons shown are from the last update kept on this phone.
saveScan.noOpenCases: This season has no open case.
saveScan.saved: Saved on this phone, it will send when you are online
saveScan.healthyHint: Healthy result: no need to open a case.

cases.emptyCasesBody: A case is created when you save a scan that shows suspected disease.
cases.emptyScansBody: Open the Scan tab to take a photo and get a result.
cases.pending: Not sent to the server yet

caseDetail.closeMessage: Only you can close a case. The app never closes it for you, even when a scan comes back healthy.
caseDetail.costNote: Taken from the season's expense book, each cost counted once.
caseDetail.pendingNote: This case has not reached the server yet, so it cannot be closed or edited.

scanSync.offline: You are offline: scans send by themselves when you are back online.
scanSync.discardMessage: The photo and result on this phone will be deleted.
scanSync.deleteMessage: A scan that never reached the server is lost for good.
scanSync.emptyBody: Saved scans show here with their sync state.
scanSync.photoGone: The photo is no longer on this phone.

content.updateFailed: Could not download the content. Check your connection and try again.
content.updateFailedKeep: Could not update the content. Using release {{release}} already on this phone.
content.needsAppUpdate: The new content needs a newer version of the app. Using the content downloaded earlier.

knowledge.noPackTitle: No content on this phone yet
knowledge.noPackBody: Download the content once, then read it even without a connection.
knowledge.noPackOffline: A connection is needed to download the content the first time. Connect, then open this screen again.
knowledge.noMatchBody: Try other words or remove a filter.
knowledge.emptyBody: Articles will show here once they are approved and published.

article.missingTitle: This article is not on the phone
article.missingBody: It may have been withdrawn or not downloaded yet. Update the content when you have a connection.
article.missingVersionBody: The cited version is not on the phone yet. Update the content when you have a connection, or open the current version.
article.oldVersion: This is version {{no}}, which is no longer the current one.
article.disclaimer: For reference only. It does not replace advice from an agricultural officer.

chat.placeholder: Ask about articles, your season or your cases
chat.searchPlaceholder: Type words to search the downloaded articles
chat.offline: You are offline, so you cannot ask. The box below searches the downloaded articles; what you typed is kept and is not sent when the connection returns.
chat.consentBody: To answer, your question and the related season and case data are sent to an external AI service. Photos, email and sign-in tokens are not sent. Without consent you can still search the downloaded articles. You can withdraw it in Settings.
chat.unsynced: {{count}} scans are not sent to the server yet, so they are not part of the answer.
chat.emptyBody: Answers rely only on approved articles and synced data, with sources you can reopen.
chat.noAnswer: There are not enough approved sources to answer. You can search under Look up.
chat.noContext: No synced farm data was used
chat.stale: The farm data is old and may not show recent changes.
chat.neverSynced: Farm data has not been synced on this phone

report.gone: This answer is no longer available to report.
report.preview: Only what is shown below is sent. The rest of the chat and your farm records are not.
report.question: Question

standards.noPackBody: Download the content once while online.
standards.emptyBody: Items will show here once an administrator publishes the checklist for fresh durian.
standards.oldVersion: An old version is for review only. The current version starts with nothing marked.
standards.noSeason: No season to mark yet. Create one under Manage farm.
standards.cached: Showing the marks saved on this phone.
standards.needsNetwork: A connection is needed to mark items. You can still read the checklist.
standards.disclaimer: The checklist is only for your own review. Marking an item does not mean your farm meets export requirements.

directory.emptyBody: Approved stores and experts will show here.
directory.noPackBody: Download the content once while online.

contact.goneBody: It may have been removed from the directory.
contact.noWay: This entry has no way to contact.
contact.disclaimer: Approved by an administrator. Please confirm yourself before visiting or buying.

signIn.intro: Sign in to keep your orchard data safe and use it on more than one phone.
signIn.failed: Could not sign in. Check your connection and try again.
signIn.notConfigured: Google/Apple sign-in is not set up in this build.
signIn.restoreNote: Sign in with the same account you used before to get your data back on a new phone. Google and Apple are separate accounts, their data is not merged.

settings.languageHint: Changes at once, no connection needed. Your data and drafts are not affected.
settings.aiOnHint: Your question and the related season and case data are sent to the AI service. Photos, email and sign-in tokens are not sent.
settings.aiOffHint: Not allowed. You can still search the articles on this phone.
settings.aiUnknown: You need a connection to see or change this.
settings.aiFailed: Could not change this. Try again when you are online.
settings.contentFailed: Could not download. The old content still works.
settings.contentUnsupported: Update the app to download newer content.

account.restoreNote: Sign in with this same account on another phone to get your data back.
account.unsyncedWarning: {{count}} scans are not on the server yet.
